email.subject1: a signal play for Nitro's partners
email.body1:
Brett, saw Nitro ran its first global Partner Advisory Boards and extended the Climb distribution partnership into Ireland.

Building out the channel like that usually means more partner-sourced accounts worth co-selling than the team can cover at scale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nitro's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brett, quick follow-up for Nitro.

In global channel, the gap is usually partner-sourced pipeline coverage: more co-sell targets across resellers and distributors than any team can touch by hand, so good partner intros go cold.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and show how Nitro can cover the partner ecosystem at scale, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brett, last bit of proof for Nitro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nitro's partner reply rate likely compares to other B2B software channels. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brett, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up advisory boards is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global channel motion? I'll tailor it to Nitro either way.
